reviewer_method.role: Explanation assessment only; no question, key, response or production-code authoring in this task.
reviewer_method.model: unknown inherited model; exact served reviewer model/settings unavailable
reviewer_method.scope: All 72 original reasoning responses: the same 24 development questions in each of three arms, with 144 ordered criterion judgments. Original and metadata-corrected answer contents are identical.
reviewer_method.procedure: Read one complete arm against each original scenario, choice set, frozen key rationale and ordered reasoning criteria; save its item ratings and completion checkpoint before reading the next arm reasoning. Compare only after all three assessments were saved. No other reviewer output was used.
reviewer_method.blinding: Arm identity, submitted selection, proposed key and coordinator statement of earlier full-bank adjudication were visible. This was not blind or independently calibrated human review. Only the selected 24 keys were rechecked here; the separate full 60-key adjudication was not reproduced.

scale.1: Partial, with a consequential gap against the stated criterion.
scale.2: Coherent and supported by the supplied facts.

reviewer_method.rating_basis: Credit requires the reasoning to satisfy the actual criterion; a correct letter, length or repetition of a requested future activity is not by itself sufficient. Unknown physical details, numeric thresholds and named authorities were not demanded when absent from the vignette.
reviewer_method.critical_error_definition: A material false or unsupported reasoning claim that reverses a decision, destroys evidence scope or authorizes an unwarranted engineering conclusion. None found in these submitted explanations.
reviewer_method.partial_criterion_rule: For the two action-specific criteria, asking parties to define responsibilities does not itself allocate responsibilities, and saying to identify an investigation does not itself provide a concrete evidence-based resolution path.
reviewer_method.comment_locations: Each item comment uses a JSON pointer in its copied packet/answers.json; the corresponding corrected-answer reasoning is identical by parsed-value comparison.
reviewer_method.source_policy: Historical/technical premises were assessed as supplied exercise facts. No external source, paid API or production action was used; no new regulatory or standards claim was introduced.
reviewer_method.tool_validation_limit: Archived scorer success validates packet/input/review bindings and aggregate structure, not the correctness of this rater judgment.

key_disposition.scope: Selected keys and rubrics only; all-bank prior adjudication supplied by coordinator and not reproduced.

comparison.observed_result: All three arms tie at 24/24 selection matches and 94/96 reviewer criterion points. The same two action-specific criteria are partial in every arm.
comparison.relative_claim: No observed reasoning advantage for either skill arm on this sample. This is not a causal performance, equivalence or superiority claim.
comparison.rater_sensitivity: If a later adjudicator interprets the two action-specific criteria broadly enough to accept process-level requests, all three arms would move to 96/96 together; observed relative separation remains zero.
comparison.substantive_observation: Across arms, explanations preserve supplied facts, conditional evidence, event identity and uncertainty. The unresolved gap is concrete assignment/resolution detail, not wrong selection or invented domain authority.

repair_examples.SEJ-029: Allocate supplier timestamp/validity reporting and guaranteed-update obligations separately from consumer age/clock checks and response to stale or invalid measurements; leave actual limits subject to the controlled-process evidence.
repair_examples.SEJ-048: Compare the previously tested configuration and environmental conditions with the revised seal geometry and relevant failure mechanism; identify the targeted analysis or test evidence and authorized applicability decision needed, without defaulting to full requalification.

limitations: One producer context per arm on 24 public development questions; no repetitions, uncertainty estimate or demonstrated generalization to difficult engineering artifact work.

The coordination context describes the same unknown inherited model across arms. Exact served model identifiers, sampling/reasoning settings, tokens, inference latency and cost were not exposed, so their equality cannot be independently verified.

Shared BuilderBob host and inherited system/developer context exposed global skill descriptions and general memory/host metadata. Packets were instruction-restricted rather than technically sandbox-isolated; no-skills does not demonstrate removal of all inherited skill knowledge.
A single model reviewer, unblinded to arm and key, used the same shared environment; no inter-rater agreement, calibrated human expert adjudication or causal estimate of skill benefit is established.

The selected authored key was checked against the supplied facts without a material disagreement. This is neither an authoritative engineering oracle nor a new validation of the historical source statements or all 60 bank keys.

All arms are at a selection ceiling and near the maximum on this rubric. Ties provide no observed separation in this sample; they do not prove equivalence, skill ineffectiveness, model superiority or release readiness.

Original submissions failed the archived parser because run.model was null. Only the explicitly documented metadata-corrected copies scored successfully; no original-submission parser success is claimed.
